mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터(콤보)*/ CMMNS_CD_ID /* 공통코드아이디 */ , CMMNS_CD_VALUE /* 공통코드값 */ , UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE /* 상위공통코드값 */ , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM /* 공통코드값명 */ FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD} /* 카페데이터콤보값 */
SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터*/ count(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '17' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터(조회)*/ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*카페명*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , AA.CAFE_MBR_NOCS AS CAFE_MBR_NOCS /*회원수*/ , AA.ETC_YN AS ETC_YN /* 활성화여부 */ , AA.CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD AS CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD_COM /*카페분류*/ , BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD /*카페분류*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.HPGE_URL_NM AS HPGE_URL_NM /*카페가기*/ , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYE100 AS AA , SAC100 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '17' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND BB.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD' AND BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD
AND CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD LIKE '%'||#{CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD_COM}||'%'
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND HPGE_URL_NM LIKE '%'||#{HPGE_URL_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터(상세)*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*번호*/ , BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*카페명*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CAFE_MBR_NOCS /*회원수*/ , CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD /*카페분류*/ , BBSCTT_CN /*카페특성*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , HPGE_URL_NM /*카페가기*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , ETC_YN /*비활성화여부*/ FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '17'
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYE100_SQ01.CURRVAL AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AYE100 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터(등롥)*/ CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD /*카페분류*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*카페명*/ , HPGE_URL_NM /*카페주소*/ , CAFE_MBR_NOCS /*회원수*/ , BBSCTT_CN /*카페특성*/ , WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , ETC_YN /*비활성화여부*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록자아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ /*이어서등록*/ ) VALUES( #{CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD} /*카페분류*/ , AYE100_SQ01.NEXTVAL /*게시글번호*/ , '17' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} /*카페명*/ , #{HPGE_URL_NM} /*카페주소*/ , #{CAFE_MBR_NOCS} /*회원수*/ , #{BBSCTT_CN} /*카페특성*/ , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}) /*작성자명*/ , #{ETC_YN} /*비활성화여부*/ , 'N' , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /*최초등록자아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최초등록일시*/ /*비횔성화여부, 이어서등록*/ )
mapper.update: UPDATE AYE100 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbscafedataListtMapper : 카페데이터(삭제)*/ DEL_YN = 'Y' /*삭제여부*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO__origin} /*게시글고유번호*/
